title: Chapter 44 A World With Thousands Of Races
content:
Chapter 44 A World With Thousands Of Races

Just as Lu Daosheng was about to take everyone away, Lu Daosheng suddenly turned around and looked at Old Yang and others.

"Everyone, what are your plans in the future?"

Upon hearing this, Mr. Yang and others were stunned.

If nothing unexpected happens, they will return to their respective galaxies and enjoy their old age.

Until one day, I quietly left this beautiful world.

But now, looking at Lu Daosheng in front of them, they hesitated.

A huge opportunity was placed in front of them.

Lu Daosheng's question undoubtedly made them start to make a decision.

Silence for a moment.

Soon, one of them stepped forward and said respectfully, "Lord Lu, I wonder if I can join the Huangcheng."

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng immediately smiled.

"welcome."

In this world, every one that can reach their level is the best in a galaxy.

What they lack is resources and opportunities.

And Lu Daosheng can give them all these.

The first person stood up, and the others also stepped forward and said, "Lord Lu, I want to join the Huangcheng."

"Same for me."

Lu Daosheng welcomed these people one by one.

Soon, only a few of these strong men who had been guarding the border for endless years were left.

Among these people are Mr. Yang and Duan Heng.

“Master,”

Behind Lu Daosheng, Ouyang Yanqing looked at Duan Heng with a complicated expression.

When Duan Heng saw Ouyang Yanqing, he laughed.

"Yan Qing, you must follow Lord Lu in the future and don't do stupid things. Master, I can only accompany you here."

"I should stay in the Eternal Star System. After all, the Eternal Temple cannot be short of a leader."

Upon hearing this, Ouyang Yanqing's eyes gradually became wet.

Master, you haven't seemed to be with me much.

However, Duan Heng did not pay attention to Ouyang Yanqing, but looked at Lu Daosheng and said solemnly: "Lord Lu, Yan Qing will leave it to you in the future."

Lu Daosheng: "..."

What are you doing? Why do you feel weird?

Around them, everyone also looked at Duan Heng with strange eyes.

It's still you guys.

Ouyang Yanqing's face was slightly red, and she lowered her head tightly and did not dare to look at Lu Daosheng.

After Lu Daosheng noticed this scene, the corners of his mouth twitched slightly.

Your master is like this, why are you still doing this behind? Lu Daosheng shook his head, ignored the master and apprentice, but looked at Mr. Yang.

Before he could speak, Mr. Yang said, "Lord Lu, I have been guarding this border line for most of my life."

As he said that, Old Yang turned around and looked at the boundary of the universe behind him.

At this moment, the defense line over there had been devastated in the war and almost turned into ruins.

"I, I will stay here from now on."

"this,,"

For a moment, everyone around looked at Old Yang with complicated expressions.

"Old Yang, why bother you?"

"Yes, Mr. Yang, the evil demon has retreated, and it is meaningless to stay here."

"Old Yang, why not join the Huangcheng with us."

Listening to the persuasion of these former comrades around him, Mr. Yang shook his head and said, "I have decided, so don't say more. From now on, follow Lord Lu to do things."

Hearing this, everyone had to give up.

On the side, Lu Daosheng looked at Old Yang, the old man who almost dedicated his voice to the Hongmeng Universe.

At this moment, Lu Daosheng was thinking, if the Hongmeng Universe had no Old Yang and he, would the ending of the Hongmeng Universe be really destroyed by the evil demon clan?

No, of course not.

In an instant, Lu Daosheng understood.

Mr. Yang is not a person, but a spirit, a spirit of selfless dedication and a new unity.

Immediately, Lu Daosheng no longer struggled, "Old Yang, the gate of my deserted city will always be opened for you."

Hearing this, Mr. Yang also laughed.

"Then I, thank you, City Lord Lu for your kindness."

Afterwards, the major galaxy forces chatted with Lu Daosheng for a few words, and Lu Daosheng took everyone in the Huangcheng to the way home.

"Huh? Lord City Lord, where is my warship?"

“It says it doesn’t want to pay attention to you.”

"ah?"

.........

In the deserted city.

On this day, the Tianxuan World ushered in the most lively moment.

The matter of Lu Daosheng saving the entire Hongmeng universe soon spread throughout the entire Hongmeng universe.

The name of the deserted city is also known to the world.

For a time, the number of people coming to the Xuangu Galaxy reached its peak in history.

And the world of Tianxuan was almost full.

As for the deserted city, although the entry fee has increased to a sky-high price.

The two brothers of the Zhang family were still in a hurry, and their hands were cramped when they collected the money.

Seeing that the number of people increased, Lu Daosheng quickly injected the world laws again, making the space in the deserted city bigger.

This did not fill the deserted city.

"I'm a damn city, this is the legendary wasteland city. I've lived so big and saw such a luxurious place for the first time."

"Who isn't?"

"Oh my God, look at this floor tiles, it's harder than that top-quality treasure. Look at this rushing stream, oh, it's incredible."

Everyone, without exception, was shocked when they first entered the deserted city.

There is such a holy place in the Hongmeng Universe?

The Xuan Gu Galaxy once again became the center of the entire universe, restoring the strongest position in ancient times.

Inside the main hall of the city lord’s mansion.

"After a hundred years, we will set off, leave the Hongmeng Universe, and head to the world of all spirits."

Lu Daosheng said slowly.

This was his decision after careful consideration.

In fact, he wanted to be faster because his daughter was still in the world of all spirits and was lonely.

But suddenly he came to the world of all spirits, which was much more powerful than the Hongmeng universe, and he was afraid that his subordinates would not be able to stand it.

Daughter, wait a little longer.

Dad will make up for you any grievances you suffer at that time.

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, Yunqi below was shocked.

And it was also the first time they learned that outside the Hongmeng universe, there is a world called the World of All Spirits.

"Sir, what is the world of all spirits?"

At this time, Gu Chen asked.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng looked at Ao Qing below.

"Ao Qing."

When Ao Qing heard his master calling him, he suddenly became excited.

"The world of all spirits is much stronger than here. There, there is no such strength as Huang Shou."

Hearing this, everyone was shocked.

There is so terrifying.

"Then why are you so weak?"

Huang Shou's soul immediately asked.

Ao Qing:...

Seeing Ao Qing being defeated, everyone burst into laughter.

It was Lu Daosheng who waved his hand before everyone stopped.

"Ao Qing, continue."

Ao Qing glared at Huang Shou and then continued, "Yes, Master."

"There are all ethnic forces in the world of spirits, and it is a world of many ethnic groups, among which there are countless powerful ethnic groups."

Speaking of this, Ao Qing raised his proud head and said proudly: "There are my dragon clan among them."

"Then how powerful is my human race?"

"I think my human race is in the world of all spirits and its strength should not be low."

Yun Qi and the others thought so.

But Lu Daosheng doesn't think so.

Because if the human race in the All Spirit Realm is really powerful, how could it be seen that the evil demon race treats the human race like this?

Sure enough, Ao Qing's answer made everyone stunned.

"There is no human race in the world of all spirits."

"What!"
